name: llm-trading-arena
description: Claude, GPT, Gemini and OpenRouter models trade the same historical candles head to head, forward simulated bar by bar, with a broadcast style replay UI. Live demo included.

paragraphs: Several large language models are given the same historical candles, one bar at a time, with no view of the future, and asked to trade. The market is then forward simulated in pure Python to see whose stop or target got hit first, and the whole thing replays bar by bar in the browser like a broadcast, with a live equity curve, trade markers, a re-sorting leaderboard, and the models' own commentary.
The live deployment is the frontend running in replay mode over run records committed to this repo. Read the What the live demo is and is not section before drawing conclusions from it.
The naive version of this idea is unusable: call an LLM on every bar, wait, and watch a 1200 bar backtest take an hour and cost a fortune. Four decisions make it fast, cheap, and honest instead.
